Marc Painter
e: marcpainter@hotmail.com/0793-99-44-948
PROFILE
A highly motivated hardworking and enthusiastic person with an excellent knowledge of data analysis,
digital transformation and data visualisation. Adaptable with a willing and flexible approach to work. I
have successfully helped transform and implement CRM/cloud-based systems, design/improve business
intelligence reports/systems and completed several data analysis projects. This has helped organisations
improve their profitability and efficiency, professionalise their reporting systems, enabled them to
manage/complete projects and win new business more easily. My software skills include an advanced
knowledge of Excel, SQL, Power BI, Access and various HR/CRM systems. Many organisations have
invited me to complete further assignments due to the quality and professionalism of my projects.
KEY SKILLS
·Office 365 - designing word-based mail merge systems, powerpoint presentations, ms forms surveys to
simplify and automate processes.
·Digital Transformation - implementing crm and cloud-based systems, user acceptance testing and
creating project documentation to digitise and improve various business functions, such as hr and
business development processes.
·Advanced Excel - using pivot tables/charts, xlook up tables, power pivot/power automate/power query to
create vba macro-enabled mail merge documents/templates to produce reports and manage projects.
·Data Visualisation - designing and improving executive-level business intelligence reports, infographics
and dashboards using Power Platform (Power Query, Power Apps and DAX functions) in Excel and Power
BI for presentations and websites.
·Data Analysis - using MS Dynamics, Python, Pyspark, SQL and Access to create ETL pipelines to
transform/automate reports and produce analysis.
CAREER DETAILS
December 2021- March 2025 Data Analyst, NHS England, London/Remote Working Assignment
·Working in a data analytics team which involved transforming client data into executive-level business
intelligence Power BI/Excel reports to help illustrate/improve data quality and design/produce reports
regarding client data submitted by NHS-funded organisations for use by various departments and
stakeholders. The data was lacking completeness or incorrect in some instances and this was important as
we needed accurate information to produce reports, identify trends and for presentations. The project also
included producing Google Analytics reports and writing reports to accompany them regarding website
traffic.
·The completed data was submitted by NHS providers via Microsoft Access templates and ingested into a
Databricks data warehouse where it was accessed and transformed into various dashboards, infographics,
business intelligence and data quality reports and to answer queries/analytical requests. The process
involved developing and optimising SQL/Python ETL pipelines/scripts (aggregate, scalar, conditional,
logical) and Excel functions and formulae (xlookup, countif, sumifs, xlookup/pivot tables, sumproduct,
slicers) in Databricks to transform and extract data efficiently.
· The data selections were transformed into Power BI or Excel business intelligence dashboards, analytical
requests or ad hoc reports. These were then accessed via Amazon Web Services in csv or Excel and
formatted accordingly. The data selections were upwards of 1 million records in size and transformed into
Power BI business intelligence reports/data visualisations using Power Query, DAX functions to produce
the data in a format for non-technical stakeholders. They were then uploaded onto the intranet or NHS
websites for stakeholders as part of regular publications or used in presentations.
·The position involved using MS Teams, Jira software, Kanban Boards and an Agile methodology to
collaborate with cross functional teams and attending daily stand-ups to ensure the tasks were completed

on schedule and any problems were resolved. I also provided assistance to clients with problematic data
submissions and managed a crm system to enable smarter targeting, provider retention and engagement
strategies and produce reports. My duties also involved anwering FOI requests from providers, ensuring
data requests/dashboards were compliant with GDPR/data governance rules and creating ETL data
pipelines to transform or automate data analytics reports using SQL queries or basic Python/Pyspark
(data science libraries used included Pandas and Numpy).
·The position also involved designing Excel VBA/HTML macro-enabled mail merge templates to improve
or automate reports to establish whether providers had submitted data of a sufficient quality (using
advanced Excel functions and formulae. My duties also involved leveraging Power Platform (Power
Automate, Power Query and Power Apps) to streamline and enhance business processes, designing user
instructions/MS Forms questionnaires to send to clients and transforming the feedback into reports, user
acceptance testing, documenting system defects and creating project documentation.
·This enabled the projects to delivered on time, improve data quality, identify trends, patterns and
insights, improve the organisation's dashboards, reporting systems and produce concise and interactive
dashboards. My achievements include receiving a letter of praise from the head of data analytics as I
worked on a project which helped automate a business intelligence and reduce the processing time which
was used by various other departments.
October 2021-November 2021 Data Analyst, University College London
·Working on a data visualisation project to produce a large suite of executive-level interactive Excel
graduate outcomes survey business intelligence reports/dashboards for use by various university
departmental managers, etc. to provide an overview regarding various statistics relating to degree courses.
These dashboards were produced in Excel and needed to be designed to give interested parties insights
into education-related metrics such as student numbers, degree course information, recruitment,
demographic information, enrolment and student feedback/complaints, statistics and trends data,
university websites in order to help identify areas for improvement, attainment gaps, etc.
·The dashboards contained course information and an overview of each degree and were used for
presentations, analysis, committee meetings, etc. They included statistics, trends and commentary in
order for people to quickly gain insights into course feedback/areas for improvement and to ensure the
univeristy was meeting quality standards, such as teaching excellence framework (tef) and student
outcomes (b3).
·The project involved researching, verifying and analysing information and carrying out desk-based
research. The information was then consolidated from various sources (university prospectuses,
collaborating with stakeholders and transformed into a suite of Excel dashboards using various functions
such as conditional formatting, advanced Excel functions and formulae (creating pivot tables, charts,
graphs, logical, text functions, etc.). The dashboards were produced in a format which was easy to navigate
and contained a contents page and index to ensure they were easy to use for non-technical audiences.
There was also some user acceptance testing and incorporating any feedback into the dashboards. The
outcome was stakeholders were presented with executive-level dashboards which summarised this
information to enable quality standards to be maintained and improved.
August 2021-September 2021 Data Analyst, Public Health England, London
·Working on an HR transformation project to enable the successful launch of a new cloud based system -
Sharepoint. This involved identifying and consolidating data from various sources (mainly different
network drives), creating folders and files in Sharepoint to accommodate incoming data, identifying and
rectifying problems with existing data, such as difficult file types/incorrect names, identifying and
classifying data into the correct sub folders. The ETL process also involved using advanced Excel functions
and formulae to (if statements, index/match, logical, nested, look up and reference, date and time, text
functions, etc.) identify missing/incorrect data (duplicated details, missing/incorrect file/folder names,
etc.) and ensure data had uploaded properly, produce HR management information, data quality reports
and dashboards.
·Creating project documentation and templates to facilitate the data transfer process, concatenating
information, interpreting data to stakeholders, producing pivot/v-look up tables, data validation lists,

transferring processed data onto Sharepoint, assigning metadata to Sharepoint folders and maintaining
version history, documenting system defects, consolidating spreadsheets, using advanced filters to locate
information and conditional formatting.
·Data research and analysis, participating in Microsoft Teams project team meetings/using Jira to resolve
data quality issues/configure the system, user acceptance testing, standardising, correcting, verifying and
improving data quality/integrity.
QUALIFICATIONS
CPC (Freight) National
CPC (Freight) International
CPC (Passenger) National
CPC (Passenger) International
NVQs Level 2 in ITQ (Information Technology Qualification) and Business Administration
GCSEs or equivalent: Commerce, English Language, Law, Psychology, Business Studies, Geography,
Design & Realisation and Maths

Transport Manager Diploma     Retail Data Analytics                        Digital Marketing
Risk Assessment (Credit)                      Python for Machine Learning           Jupyter Notebook
Health & Safety                    Data Visualisation in Tableau         SQL for Data Science
Nutrition and Health                                    ChatGPT for Beginners            Statistical Methods
Marketing & Retail Analytics                      Introduction to R Beginner         SQL, SSRS & SSIS
Retail Management                 Jira Project Management        Microsoft Co-pilot
Project Management                 Google Analytics
Data Visualization With Power BI             Business Intelligence using Excel
Business Intelligence and Data Mining  Data Analytics with SQL and Python

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

I have a wide range IT skills and these include: Microsoft Excel, Excel VBA, Microsoft Fabric, Workday,
Tableau, Power BI, Google Analytics/Tag Manager, Data Studio, Splunk, CSS, HTML, SAP, Salesforce,
Faststats, Adobe Illustrator/Analytics, Microsoft Dynamics, Spotfire, Qlikview, Microstrategy, Raiser's
Edge, NetSuite, Hubspot, Zoho, Xero, Visio, SQL, SSRS, SSIS, SPSS and MS Project.
Current Clean Driving Licence (Pass Plus)
